module_lifecycle.platform.defaultsSubtit: Installed into every new tenant after its plan, through the plan check. Existing tenants are not changed; apply the list to one from its Modules page.

module_lifecycle.platform.hint.unlisted: Not listed. It arrives only with a plan that covers it, from an operator or the default list.

module_lifecycle.tenant.blockDescription: The tenant can no longer install or reactivate it. If it is on, it is switched off now together with the modules that need it; the data is kept. Unblocking switches nothing back on.
module_lifecycle.tenant.cascade: Also uninstall the modules that need it: {{list}}
module_lifecycle.tenant.intro: Actions run through the same rules as the tenant's own store: the plan still applies (grant a product first to give more), a block stops installs and reactivation, and every action is audited in the tenant and the platform.
